summary: Audio.Core supplies pure requests and record-only evidence. Audio.Host supplies the device seam and Null/OpenAL realization; Engine supplies mixing, fades, ducking and spatial behavior. Elmish is optional and independent of FS.GG.UI. Host/Engine/Elmish redistribute replaceable dynamically linked OpenAL Soft; Core carries no native OpenAL.
title: Pure audio requests with optional device realization
